import java.util.StringTokenizer

fun main() {
    val br = System.`in`.bufferedReader()

    val st1 = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    var hpY = st1.nextToken().toInt()
    var atkY = st1.nextToken().toInt()
    var defY = st1.nextToken().toInt()

    val st2 = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val hpM = st2.nextToken().toInt()
    val atkM = st2.nextToken().toInt()
    val defM = st2.nextToken().toInt()

    val st3 = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val hCost = st3.nextToken().toInt()
    val aCost = st3.nextToken().toInt()
    val dCost = st3.nextToken().toInt()

    var ans = Int.MAX_VALUE

    // Upper bounds for search (safe but small due to constraints)
    val maxAtkY = 200
    val maxDefY = 200

    for (atk in atkY..maxAtkY) {
        val dmgToMonster = maxOf(0, atk - defM)
        if (dmgToMonster == 0) continue

        for (def in defY..maxDefY) {
            val dmgToYang = maxOf(0, atkM - def)

            val turnsToKillMonster = (hpM + dmgToMonster - 1) / dmgToMonster
            val requiredHpY = if (dmgToYang == 0) 1 else dmgToYang * (turnsToKillMonster - 1) + 1

            val extraHp = maxOf(0, requiredHpY - hpY)
            val extraAtk = atk - atkY
            val extraDef = def - defY

            val cost = extraHp * hCost + extraAtk * aCost + extraDef * dCost
            if (cost < ans) ans = cost
        }
    }

    println(ans)
}

    for (atkInc in 0..200) {
        val newATK = ATKY + atkInc

        if (damageToMonster == 0) continue

        for (defInc in 0..200) {
            val newDEF = DEFY + defInc
            val damageToYang = maxOf(0, ATKM - newDEF)

            val turnsToKillMonster = (HPM + damageToMonster - 1) / damageToMonster
            val requiredHP = if (damageToYang == 0) 1 else damageToYang * (turnsToKillMonster - 1) + 1

            val hpInc = maxOf(0, requiredHP - HPY)

            val cost = atkInc * a + defInc * d + hpInc * h
            if (cost < minCost) {
                minCost = cost
            }
        }
    }

    println(minCost)
